decision.reason: [ev-d233a6889a2e] says only that the HTTP method of the applicationset generate endpoint changed to avoid route conflicts. A changed method on a served endpoint is better modelled as an api-endpoint (METHOD /path) moving to a new identity than as a free-form protocol-behavior. The excerpt does not give the old method, the new method or the path, so neither the subject identity nor the before/after of the change can be pinned down. To decide, we need the PR #20758 diff or the API docs showing the old and new routes.
